worlds.name: Quantum Physicist
worlds.fantasy: A quiet explorer makes impossible physics feel personal.
worlds.shape_language: Broken circles, offset doubles, visible gaps; long coat against tiny floating objects.
worlds.materials: Matte ceramic, optical glass, woven ivory fabric.
worlds.motion: Objects synchronise, diverge and reunite; slow precision.
worlds.avoid: Avoid brass clocks, generic starfield wallpaper and full glowing spheres.
worlds.collection_story: Start with a repaired coat and lucky pencil; collect the laboratory's strange occupants; the Dyson Sphere becomes the room's conversation piece.

worlds.name: Dragon Scholar
worlds.fantasy: A gentle keeper befriends creatures from the margins of old books.
worlds.shape_language: Scalloped edges, squat eggs, sweeping dragon arcs and thick book spines.
worlds.materials: Soft leather, paper layers, warm iron, worn wool.
worlds.motion: Curl, hatch, unfold and settle; warmth without frantic fire.
worlds.avoid: Avoid knight armour and generic blue space dragons; keep a sheltering, domestic mood.
worlds.collection_story: A campfire and tiny dragon establish affection; book wings and the Void Dragon turn the keeper into a mythical host.

worlds.name: Neon Hacker
worlds.fantasy: An inventive street artist gives abandoned digital objects a second life.
worlds.shape_language: Stepped corners, open kites, broken diagonals, asymmetric hems.
worlds.materials: Rubberised cloth, translucent flat panels, brushed aluminium.
worlds.motion: Fold, slide and click into place; deliberate edits rather than flicker.
worlds.avoid: Avoid circuitry wallpaper and random scrolling symbols; Circuit Sage owns the practical workbench.
worlds.collection_story: A stickered skateboard leads to a Data Phantom and an unfinished crown; identity comes from cheerful creative tinkering.

worlds.name: Arctic Explorer
worlds.fantasy: A resilient traveller builds a warm pocket of home in a huge cold landscape.
worlds.shape_language: Cocoon bodies, broad paws, flattened globes and long scarf lines.
worlds.materials: Padded cloth, frosted glass, braided rope, worn enamel.
worlds.motion: Heavy cloth settles; small creatures take careful steps.
worlds.avoid: Avoid covering everything in spikes or snow particles; comfort is the defining emotion.
worlds.collection_story: Tea, a postcard parka and a loyal pup make the expedition personal; the dragon wake celebrates how far the traveller has come.

worlds.name: Cell Voyager
worlds.fantasy: A curious miniaturist explores a soft, strange living world.
worlds.shape_language: Lobed puddles, membranes, rounded portholes and hollow stone giants.
worlds.materials: Soft translucent gel, frosted enamel, smooth porous stone.
worlds.motion: Stretch, compress and drift; no generic mammal gait for microbes.
worlds.avoid: Avoid literal medical realism and DNA ribbon duplication; DNA Dreamer owns weaving.
worlds.collection_story: Pocket tools and a cell lantern lead into a miniature sanctuary watched over by a huge gentle guardian.

worlds.name: Alchemical Apprentice
worlds.fantasy: A slightly chaotic kitchen experimenter turns everyday scraps into wonders.
worlds.shape_language: Squat flasks, crooked corks, bent handles and pot-like bodies.
worlds.materials: Cloudy glass, stained canvas, copper, cork.
worlds.motion: Stir, rock, shuffle sideways; handmade imperfections stay visible.
worlds.avoid: Avoid sleek crystal laboratories; Prism Chemist owns clean optics.
worlds.collection_story: The rubber duck belongs beside the cauldron crab; practical experiments grow into a strange welcoming bottle garden.

worlds.name: Bard of Books
worlds.fantasy: A warm storyteller brings unfinished books and stolen bookmarks to life.
worlds.shape_language: Long ribbons, fan pages, rounded book bodies and a tall griffin crest.
worlds.materials: Quilted cloth, thick paper, wax, soft leather.
worlds.motion: Turn pages, peek, bow; characters protect stories.
worlds.avoid: Avoid knight heraldry and elemental symbols; the library is personal and theatrical.
worlds.collection_story: Revision notes and a raccoon lead to a floating library; archive wings and the griffin make the storyteller instantly recognisable.

worlds.name: Clockwork Historian
worlds.fantasy: A patient restorer finds beauty in mechanisms with a history.
worlds.shape_language: Broad watch faces, short pendulums, mismatched eyes and stacked arches.
worlds.materials: Aged brass, wood, polished repair seams, worn wool.
worlds.motion: Tick, wind, turn and settle; all mechanisms appear repairable.
worlds.avoid: Avoid time rifts and wings made from clock hands; Time Traveller owns impossible chronology.
worlds.collection_story: A small repaired calculator becomes a friend; the owl and library fox reward a collector who values old things.

worlds.name: Nebula Navigator
worlds.fantasy: A relaxed navigator crosses huge skies with a tiny crew.
worlds.shape_language: Long sails, broad fins, ship windows and generous V-shaped routes.
worlds.materials: Sailcloth, soft painted metal, cloudy glass.
worlds.motion: Glide, bank, float; expansive calm rather than precise orbital motion.
worlds.avoid: Avoid ceremonial graduation stars and astronomical instruments; this fantasy is travel.
worlds.collection_story: Balloons and a paper rocket begin the voyage; the Cosmic Whale makes the sky feel inhabited.

worlds.name: Coral Curator
worlds.fantasy: A tidepool collector curates a bright miniature reef.
worlds.shape_language: Scalloped shells, coral branches, round frogs and broad chest lids.
worlds.materials: Sea glass, shell, pale rope, porous stone.
worlds.motion: Open shells, bubble, hop and peer into containers.
worlds.avoid: Avoid pressure helmets and deep-sea darkness; Ocean Analyst owns the abyss.
worlds.collection_story: Sea-glass treasures and a lucky frog lead to a living reef and a golem that values one shiny pebble.

worlds.name: Crystal Cartographer
worlds.fantasy: A pathfinder maps landscapes no one has named yet.
worlds.shape_language: Folded zigzags, triangular openings and stepped contour sheets.
worlds.materials: Faceted stone, sturdy paper, matte leather.
worlds.motion: Unfold maps, tilt facets, reveal hidden cavities.
worlds.avoid: Avoid clean laboratory refraction; crystals are geological finds with rough outer edges.
worlds.collection_story: A chalk marker and specimen drawer support the journey; the Crown of Equations turns careful navigation into a personal emblem.

worlds.name: Fractal Wizard
worlds.fantasy: A playful spatial magician makes impossible geometry feel tangible.
worlds.shape_language: Nested frames, branching forks, impossible knots and unequal scales.
worlds.materials: Matte lacquer, carved wood, thick folded fabric.
worlds.motion: Fold inward, recurse, align and open; one clear impossible action.
worlds.avoid: Avoid hologram noise and generic spiral tunnels; negative space does the work.
worlds.collection_story: An impossible pin becomes a portal; a patient turtle grounds the fantasy while a Black Hole provides the ultimate display piece.

worlds.name: Solar Researcher
worlds.fantasy: A sunny rooftop maker collects warmth and small useful inventions.
worlds.shape_language: Broad fans, parasol curves, low benches and splayed gecko feet.
worlds.materials: Sun-faded cotton, warm brass, terracotta, matte solar panels.
worlds.motion: Angle towards light, bask and gently unfold.
worlds.avoid: Avoid religious sun iconography and aggressive flare effects; the mood is bright domestic optimism.
worlds.collection_story: The first window and desk lamp reward everyday study; the gecko and solar wings expand a warm rooftop identity.

worlds.name: Lunar Archivist
worlds.fantasy: A quiet night archivist keeps a comfortable place for restless minds.
worlds.shape_language: Deep crescents, long narrow cloaks, circular book pages and huge moth wings.
worlds.materials: Velvet, pale wax, chalky stone, soft silver.
worlds.motion: Yawn, fan wings, leave quiet footprints; patient pauses matter.
worlds.avoid: Avoid busy constellation instruments and neon nightclub effects; preserve stillness.
worlds.collection_story: A sleepy cat and blanket support a cosy night identity; the throne and Lunar Tiger provide dignified aspiration.

worlds.name: Forest Guardian
worlds.fantasy: A woodland host shelters small creatures and keeps old stories growing.
worlds.shape_language: Root forks, broad brush tails, squat jars and uneven mushroom caps.
worlds.materials: Living wood, wool, frosted jars, soft leaf surfaces.
worlds.motion: Unfurl leaves, curl tails and lean in curious pauses.
worlds.avoid: Avoid brass gardening inventions; Botanical Inventor owns mechanisms and cultivated plants.
worlds.collection_story: Mushroom hats and fireflies lead into a reading tree; Shadow Wolf and Spirit Fox express different temperaments.

worlds.name: Volcano Geologist
worlds.fantasy: A bold explorer finds friendly life in a landscape of cooling stone.
worlds.shape_language: Broken slabs, wide craters, porous round bodies and large cutout wing gaps.
worlds.materials: Porous rock, heavy canvas, cooled glass, warm seams.
worlds.motion: Expand, cool and settle; no constant eruption.
worlds.avoid: Avoid endless flame recolours; show rough outer surfaces and quiet inner heat.
worlds.collection_story: A volcano backpack and campfire grow into great stone wings; phoenix and winter dragon contrast heat with calm grandeur.

worlds.name: Prism Chemist
worlds.fantasy: A careful colour collector turns glass and light into small living sculptures.
worlds.shape_language: Clean wedges, hollow crystal shells, broad prisms and single large droplets.
worlds.materials: Clear glass, frosted facets, enamel, clean cotton.
worlds.motion: Refract, rotate and align; sparse optical accents.
worlds.avoid: Avoid geological rubble and occult potions; every silhouette should feel deliberately assembled.
worlds.collection_story: Marbles and a jellybean slime keep the set playful; the phoenix and broad glass wings provide a sculptural centrepiece.

worlds.name: Story Knight
worlds.fantasy: A self-appointed guardian steps into an unfinished fairy tale.
worlds.shape_language: Swallowtails, broad shields, pop-up towers and squat book stacks.
worlds.materials: Canvas banners, tin, paper board, soft leather.
worlds.motion: Bow, open a drawbridge, rearrange a book; playful ceremony.
worlds.avoid: Avoid realistic weapons and borrowed franchise armour; courage comes through posture and kindness.
worlds.collection_story: Pirate hats and treasure maps support play; a book golem and century-earned guardian make persistence visible.

worlds.name: Probability Pilot
worlds.fantasy: An easygoing sky pilot enjoys the journey and all its possible routes.
worlds.shape_language: Windsock tubes, folded chevrons, flat rays and crossed boards.
worlds.materials: Canvas, paper, soft enamel, weathered timber.
worlds.motion: Bank, glide and make a gentle landing; no spinning prize dice.
worlds.avoid: Avoid cosmic grandeur and heavy aircraft detail; the collection is airy and low-tech.
worlds.collection_story: Paper planes and surfboard wings give a carefree identity; the landing trail celebrates reliable progress.

worlds.name: Magnetic Mechanic
worlds.fantasy: A resourceful mechanic builds clever friends from leftovers.
worlds.shape_language: Heavy U shapes, broad cubes, low badgers and huge uneven wheels.
worlds.materials: Scratched metal, denim, rubber, reclaimed wood.
worlds.motion: Levitate heavy objects, clunk gently and tidy small parts.
worlds.avoid: Avoid lightning everywhere; visible weight against magnetic suspension is the signature.
worlds.collection_story: Socket belts and scrap furniture make ownership feel personal; the levitation engine turns repair into quiet magic.

worlds.name: DNA Dreamer
worlds.fantasy: A dream weaver turns threads of memory into soft living forms.
worlds.shape_language: Forked ribbons, wide gills, open loom frames and trailing cloth fans.
worlds.materials: Woven ribbon, soft glass, brushed wood, plush fur.
worlds.motion: Braid, separate, curl and breathe; soft continuous transitions.
worlds.avoid: Avoid cell membranes and laboratory microscopes; this theme is weaving and inherited stories.
worlds.collection_story: A loom, axolotl and memory seeds create a gentle identity; the wolf and phoenix turn ribbons into memorable creatures.

worlds.name: Storm Scribe
worlds.fantasy: A weather-loving writer finds comfort and drama in rain.
worlds.shape_language: Long sweeping strokes, umbrella canopies, wide boots and low paper boats.
worlds.materials: Waxed cloth, water glass, paper, matte rubber.
worlds.motion: Write a single curve, sway clouds and rock on puddles.
worlds.avoid: Avoid strobing lightning and angry failure weather; the rain is welcome.
worlds.collection_story: Puddle boots and paper boats are immediately approachable; calligraphic wings make the writer's silhouette distinctive.

worlds.name: Ancient Astronomer
worlds.fantasy: A patient sky watcher collects instruments and stories beneath an open horizon.
worlds.shape_language: Broad discs, long pointers, low dunes and tall open stone arches.
worlds.materials: Carved stone, brass, woven wraps, cloudy glass.
worlds.motion: Align pointers, turn slowly and hold still to observe.
worlds.avoid: Avoid spaceship cabins and magical clocks; historical inspiration remains an original imagined culture.
worlds.collection_story: A lucky pebble and simple wrap lead to ceremonial crown and eclipse wings; patient observation defines the fantasy.

worlds.name: Ocean Analyst
worlds.fantasy: A calm deep-sea naturalist keeps a cosy shelter in an immense ocean.
worlds.shape_language: Pressure-window circles, broad bells, long lantern stalks and curved shell rooms.
worlds.materials: Worn enamel, thick glass, rope, soft waterproof cloth.
worlds.motion: Sink slowly, look through windows and pass in the distance.
worlds.avoid: Avoid bright coral gardens; make depth, pressure and warm interior space distinctive.
worlds.collection_story: Deck shoes and a helmet hermit keep the collection friendly; the sanctuary makes the abyss feel like home.

worlds.name: Logic Samurai
worlds.fantasy: A composed problem solver expresses patience through graceful, deliberate objects.
worlds.shape_language: Open squares, long crane necks, broad sleeve planes and incomplete brush circles.
worlds.materials: Paper, matte ceramic, linen, smooth stone.
worlds.motion: Bow, fold once and rest; intention over spectacle.
worlds.avoid: Avoid mixing unrelated cultural motifs or using exaggerated warrior caricatures; keep a consistent garment and craft vocabulary.
worlds.collection_story: Frog charms and a quiet stone desk lead to a crown of interlocking forms and formal archivist robes.

worlds.name: Circuit Sage
worlds.fantasy: A friendly repair-cafe inventor gives everyday electronics a personality.
worlds.shape_language: Round coils, thick cable loops, bell bodies and rectangular whiteboards.
worlds.materials: Ceramic, copper, canvas, soft painted plastic.
worlds.motion: Polish, draw a smile and make one measured pulse.
worlds.avoid: Avoid cyberpunk shards; Neon Hacker owns angular digital magic.
worlds.collection_story: A whiteboard pal and repair booth make the collection welcoming; a living circuit celebrates patient making.

worlds.name: Botanical Inventor
worlds.fantasy: An optimistic gardener makes small machines for living things.
worlds.shape_language: Seed leaves, egg glasshouses, spiral vines and huge teapot handles.
worlds.materials: Terracotta, glass, garden twine, light brass.
worlds.motion: Grow, water, crank and unfold; plants lead the movement.
worlds.avoid: Avoid ancient mystical forests; these are cultivated, slightly improvised inventions.
worlds.collection_story: A snail mailbox and teapot tortoise create affection; greenhouse wings turn cultivation into a bold personal silhouette.

worlds.name: Elemental Librarian
worlds.fantasy: A welcoming librarian lets the weather and wild world into the reading room.
worlds.shape_language: Four unequal panels, open books, long serpentine page fans and tall ladders.
worlds.materials: Cloth, stone, paper, restrained water surfaces.
worlds.motion: Turn one page, open one arch and settle; each element has a material role.
worlds.avoid: Avoid four identical recolours; stone, water, leaf and cloud must change the outline and surface behaviour.
worlds.collection_story: Highlighters and slippers ground the fantasy; the Library Leviathan makes the collection's great reward immediately memorable.

worlds.name: Time Traveller
worlds.fantasy: A stylish wanderer carries souvenirs from journeys that have not happened yet.
worlds.shape_language: Long clock hands, swept feather spars, slanted panes and half-capes.
worlds.materials: Worn velvet, brushed brass, clear glass, stitched leather.
worlds.motion: Pause, catch up and align; always smooth rather than stuttering.
worlds.avoid: Avoid museum restoration clutter; Clockwork Historian owns physical repair, this theme owns impossible time.
worlds.collection_story: Mismatched gloves and a borrowed-tomorrow title lead to raven, wings and a fractured doorway; a collection about movement.

worlds.name: Aurora Graduate
worlds.fantasy: A joyful graduate carries the warmth of a milestone into everyday life.
worlds.shape_language: Page fans, broad stair ribbons, rounded stars and soft graduation folds.
worlds.materials: Matte satin, paper, soft glass, brushed warm metal.
worlds.motion: Bow, unfold and look upward; confident celebration with quiet pauses.
worlds.avoid: Avoid permanent confetti and status labels implying academic attainment from purchases; the fantasy is personal celebration.
worlds.collection_story: A desk of small wins and ribbon trainers build towards aurora wings and an observatory that celebrates a long journey.

presentation.shape_story: A solid warm brown miniature dachshund: very long low body, short sturdy legs, long rounded muzzle, exceptionally soft drooping ears and a gently lowered inquisitive head. A plain teal collar carries a small brass D tag.
presentation.motion_brief: Sniffs a short trail, looks up for reassurance, then curls into a compact doughnut. Ears settle after the head stops.
presentation.coat: Solid brown, without black saddle or tan-point eyebrows.
presentation.static_fallback: Relaxed low standing pose, head slightly down.
presentation.unlock_text: Proposed coin shop: 3,600 study coins; no level gate and no drop-pool entry.

catalogue.name: Dotty
catalogue.art_brief: A black-and-tan miniature dachshund: long low body, short legs, glossy charcoal back, warm tan eyebrows, muzzle edges, chest and paws. A perkier head tilt and raised tail distinguish her silhouette; a plain coral collar carries a brass D tag.

presentation.shape_story: A black-and-tan miniature dachshund: long low body, short legs, glossy charcoal back, warm tan eyebrows, muzzle edges, chest and paws. A perkier head tilt and raised tail distinguish her silhouette; a plain coral collar carries a brass D tag.
presentation.motion_brief: Tilts her head, makes a small front-paws-down play bow and trots back to the avatar. One floppy ear lifts with the turn.
presentation.coat: Black-and-tan markings with two clear tan eyebrow patches.
presentation.static_fallback: Alert side-on stance, curious head tilt and raised tail.
presentation.unlock_text: Proposed coin shop: 3,600 study coins; no level gate and no drop-pool entry.
